summary: Recommended sequence plus the owner's changes (Nov 11, 2026): Fluorescent & HID split, fluorescent moved to LT1 #11; Project Readiness to be reframed from projects to service calls.

LT1.theme: Safety, equipment, tools, lighting basics (incandescent and fluorescent), then project and retrofit work
courses: Safety first: orientation, safety culture and PPE
Safety first: ladders and fall protection
Safety first: heat, cold and hazardous materials
Safety first: lockout/tagout before any hands-on work
Know and own your tools and meter
Moved from LT3: equipment operation (scissor, boom, rolling scaffold) early, well before exterior work
Customer service and work orders from day one
Electrical basics needed before lighting systems
Your change: fluorescent systems split out of Fluorescent & HID and moved to LT1, before project and retrofit work
Moved from LT2: project-type work is part of a new tech's job
Moved from LT2: retrofit work early (builds on the fluorescent basics in LT1-C05)

LT2.theme: Circuits, HID and LED systems, troubleshooting, service work, then track and low-voltage
courses: HID systems split out of Fluorescent & HID; stays in LT2 before LED drivers
Moved from LT3: lighting progression continues to LED drivers
Moved from LT1: switches and receptacles after circuits and meters
Moved from LT1: parts knowledge and sourcing once techs know the systems

LT3.theme: Exterior work (aerial lifts already learned), controls, emergency and specialty systems
courses: Exterior work now that lifts are mastered
Rigging and pole removal follows exterior

LT3-S23: Moves with Aerial Work Platforms (rolling scaffold)
LT3-S27: Moves with Aerial Work Platforms (company lift inspection)

notes.LT2-C04a: Your note: Separate out Fluorescent training for HID. Split by lesson: L1-L2 fluorescent here; hours and quiz split are estimates until the course is rebuilt.
notes.LT2-C04b: Your note: Separate out Fluorescent training for HID. Split by lesson: L3-L5 HID here (HID skills LT2-S04 and LT2-S20 stay in LT2).
notes.LT2-C12: Your note: This should be shifting from projects to Service Calls. To do when the content is updated: reframe the course so new techs start on project work in LT1 and learn to shift to service calls later.
